evidence.title: Neuromorphic YC S26 Launch Video
evidence.excerpt: Meet Neuromorphic: the brain for robots. Onboard any robot in minutes, not weeks. Our onboard AI turns plain-language instructions into safe robot workflows, and the same brain works across quadrupeds, wheeled robots, and humanoids. Already live in wet labs, where our first biotech customer went from first conversation to daily robot operations within one week. Backed by Y Combinator and NVIDIA Inception. #YCombinator #Robotics #AI #LabAutomation #Biotech #construction #oilandgas #datacenter
